lines.text: Ephraim was exalted in Israel, but he incurred guilt through Dagon and died, and they made silver idols.
The LORD knew them in the wilderness, but once satisfied, their hearts became proud and they forgot Him.
The LORD says He will pounce like a lion, lurk like a leopard, and attack like a wolf robbed of cubs.
The LORD asks where their king is, and says in His anger He gave a king and in wrath took him away.
An east wind from the LORD will dry up Ephraim's spring, and Samaria will bear guilt for rebelling against her God.
